phase.intro: Say hello and share your goal

tipsBody.waiting: Clear your desk, close extra tabs and pick one task.
tipsBody.intro: Say hi and tell your partner the one thing you'll work on. Keep it short and specific.
tipsBody.focus: Work quietly. Your mic was muted for you; unmute any time.
tipsBody.wrap: Unmute and tell your partner how it went. Then mark your outcome.
